failure.message:
AssertionError: Home Assistant changed Entity._async_registry_updated (homeassistant/helpers/entity.py): a loaded MQTT entity that is disabled and removed in one synchronous step now makes core MQTT publish its clear-on-remove on the shared discovery topic, which deletes the rows other instances keep (CR-01). The no-clear guarantee relied on the eager task that unsubscribes the entity before the remove event. Next step: let takeover.remove_replay_twins wait until the disabled entity has left entity_sources before removing it, or publish the migrate payload first (review 2 IN-02, research Pitfall 9). assert [(None, True), (None, True)] == []
